summary.name: AppCode
summary.one_liner: AppCode is JetBrains' IDE for iOS and macOS development in Swift and Objective-C, no longer sold as a commercial product as of December 14, 2022.
use_cases: writing Swift code for iOS apps
navigating large iOS or macOS projects
finding and fixing code issues with quick-fixes
summary.what_it_does: AppCode is an IDE aimed at iOS and macOS development in Swift and Objective-C. The page describes it as focused on code quality, code navigation, smart code completion, and on-the-fly code analysis with quick-fixes. It also highlights code refactorings. The page states that AppCode is no longer available as a commercial product as of December 14, 2022, and gives v2023.1.5 (released 12 June 2024) as the latest bug-fix update. It points to JetBrains Fleet as a polyglot editor that supports Swift.
notable: Smart code completion and code navigation for Swift and Objective-C
caveats: No longer available as a commercial product as of December 14, 2022
Latest update is a bug-fix release (v2023.1.5, June 2024)
JetBrains Fleet is pointed to as a successor-style alternative for Swift
